question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: The camera at the location "KeynoteHall_Stage" showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast with a peak head_count to overnight average head_count ratio of approximately 70.57. This ratio falls within the "tens" order of magnitude.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location IN ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle', 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA', 'DemoBooth_Intel', 'KeynoteHall_Stage', 'FoodCourt_North']
    AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.camera_location AS location, ch.hour_utc AS hour, ch.avg_hc AS avg_hc, ch.peak_hc AS peak_hc
}
WITH location, hour, avg_hc, peak_hc
ORDER BY location, hour
WITH location, collect({hour: hour, avg_hc: avg_hc, peak_hc: peak_hc}) AS hourly_data
CALL {
  WITH hourly_data
  UNWIND hourly_data AS data
  WITH data
  WHERE substring(data.hour, 11, 2) IN ['00', '01', '02', '03', '04', '05']
  RETURN avg(data.avg_hc) AS overnight_avg_hc
}
WITH location, hourly_data, overnight_avg_hc
UNWIND hourly_data AS data
WITH location, data.peak_hc AS peak_hc, overnight_avg_hc
WITH location, peak_hc, overnight_avg_hc, peak_hc / overnight_avg_hc AS ratio
ORDER BY ratio DESC
RETURN location, ratio, CASE
  WHEN ratio >= 100 THEN 'hundreds'
  WHEN ratio >= 10 THEN 'tens'
  ELSE 'units'
END AS order_of_magnitude
LIMIT 1
